India Blockchain Tour

A meetup that became a multi-city tour. This page uses only confirmed facts. Commercial totals are marked TODO on purpose.

Started2016
Origin8 people
202610 cities
Reached13,000+

Anupam Varshney has run events since 2016. India Blockchain Tour began as an 8-person Bitcoin meetup in Delhi. It is now in its 5th edition, across 10 cities in 2026, reaching 13,000+ attendees.

That arc is the operating proof behind Octaloop’s work for other organizers: sponsorship sales, ticket sales, and the reporting that gives a sponsor a reason to return. IBT is Octaloop’s own tour, not a client logo with a made-up ROI.

What this shows an organizer

A sales and marketing team that has had to fill its own rooms, city after city, from a meetup of eight. The 13,000+ figure is attendees reached. It is not a paid-ticket total, and this page does not treat it as one.
